purpose: Everything R7 closure does NOT establish. Read alongside 01 and 02; a green suite alone closes nothing.
explicit_non_claims: NOT an adoption of the C4 freeze
NOT removal of the live-execution blocker by this lane; only HQ may do that, after independent hostile acceptance
NOT an execution of live C4
NOT a qualification of any real survey source
NOT a portability guarantee to any host other than this one

limitations.limitation: The base CPython interpreter is not version-controlled.
limitations.detail: It lives at LOCAL_COURTS/tooling/python/cpython-3.11.3-macos-x86_64-none, is untracked in Git, and is now fully digest-identified as 11d6f541a870a141249ce98d45834a6789e29c07031e85ce17f3e67f24c535f6. A second host cannot obtain this binary from the repository.
limitations.consequence: R7's fingerprint component is closed on THIS host. Portability of the interpreter remains open.
limitations.to_close: vendor or commit the interpreter build, or record a fetchable upstream artifact plus its expected digest.

limitations.limitation: The environment is bound to this exact host and volume.
limitations.detail: Durability rests on the path /Users/matthewsmith/Desktop/Rawlsing/LOCAL_COURTS/qualification/r7-c4-source-free-venv existing on the persistent volume. It is not a managed, reproducible artifact.
limitations.consequence: Deletion or reimage of the host destroys the environment. The recipe allows reconstruction on a host with the same interpreter available, but not without it.
limitations.to_close: store the environment definition as a machine-readable lock in-repo and add a rebuild-and-verify path.

limitations.limitation: LOCAL_COURTS is untracked but NOT gitignored.
limitations.detail: No .gitignore rule covers it in this repository. git status shows '?? LOCAL_COURTS/'. A routine `git add -A` in the shared clone would attempt to add a 332M virtual environment.
limitations.consequence: an accidental large commit, or an accidental disclosure of local tooling paths.
limitations.to_close: HQ should add an ignore rule. This lane did not edit .gitignore because it lies outside the declared write terrain.

limitations.limitation: Host disk reached 99% utilisation with roughly 6.3GiB free during this work, down from about 13GiB at the start.
limitations.detail: The qualification venv is 332M; pip caches and the second reference environment also occupy space. Constrained disk has already forced payload withholding once on a sibling estate (NoviyMac, 800MiB free).
limitations.consequence: A governed live run against multi-gigabyte sources could fail or silently degrade on this host for reasons unrelated to R7.
limitations.to_close: free space and set a minimum-free-space precondition for the live runner.

limitations.limitation: A broken sibling symlink exists in the interpreter toolchain directory.
limitations.detail: cpython-3.11-macos-x86_64-none is a dangling symlink to /Users/matthewsmith/LOCAL_COURTS/..., which does not exist. The live interpreter is the cpython-3.11.3-macos-x86_64-none directory.
limitations.consequence: any recipe, script or operator following the shorter name fails.
limitations.to_close: remove or repair the dangling symlink. Not done here: outside declared write terrain.

limitations.limitation: Reproduction still depends on external package indexes.
limitations.detail: narwhals is now pinned at 2.26.0, which closes the specific unpinned-transitive defect. All 14 resolved packages are exactly pinned. But availability of those exact artifacts from an index is not a local guarantee.
limitations.consequence: a rebuild months later may fail or require an internal mirror; the digests recorded here let any rebuild be verified rather than trusted.
limitations.to_close: record full per-distribution artifact digests and vendor wheels, or adopt an internal mirror.

limitations.limitation: The requalification ran at the FREEZE tree, not at this branch's tree.
limitations.detail: This branch's HEAD does not contain the accepted C3 code and lacks all six authoritative court files. The court was therefore run in a detached worktree at 8ff40d37.
limitations.consequence: the 55/55 twice result is bound to the freeze bytes, which is what the commission required, and is explicitly NOT a statement about this branch's own rawlsing_next content.
limitations.to_close: HQ must decide the authoritative lineage before the live run. See 05.

limitations.limitation: No source-access denial was exercised, by design.
limitations.detail: This is a source-free lane. No survey path was resolved, stat-ed or hashed, so nothing here demonstrates behaviour against real source storage or real permission boundaries.
limitations.consequence: the warrant-side and source-hold controls remain entirely unexercised by this work.
limitations.to_close: out of scope; requires separate source-access authority.

limitations.limitation: Compiled-extension digests are bound to this host's wheel resolution.
limitations.detail: All five extensions are byte-identical across two pre-existing environments on this host, which is strong evidence of local reproducibility. It is not evidence that a rebuild on another host or another wheel build yields identical binaries.
limitations.to_close: compare full digests on any additional host before relying on it.

limitations.limitation: The static closure audit is a source-text audit, not a runtime trace.
limitations.detail: Zero dynamic-loader, subprocess, duckdb and ee_p2x/fiabc edges was established by regex over module blobs in the 23-module closure. This reproduces the method C4C3 used and the property it relied on.
limitations.consequence: a dynamically constructed edge that never appears literally in source would not be detected. The 55/55 court provides behavioural corroboration but not exhaustive edge proof.
limitations.to_close: a runtime import-hook trace if HQ wants stronger assurance than the prior grain.

what_is_actually_established: R7 fingerprint component: full 64-hex SHA-256 for the interpreter, libpython and all five compiled extensions, with every previously recorded 32-hex prefix shown to be a correct truncation rather than a wrong value.

R7 reproducibility component: a durable non-temporary environment, a complete 14-package exactly-pinned inventory including narwhals==2.26.0, a full recipe, and a byte-exact reproduction of the accepted historical 13-package seed as an independent positive control.
The exact freeze code requalified source-free in that environment: authoritative C3 six-file court, denominator asserted before the run, 55/55 twice, deterministic environment.

Call-path binding: the 21-module and 23-module closures independently recomputed and matched; all C4 layer modules imported from the freeze tree; zero unexpected dynamic-loader, subprocess or source edges.
what_remains_unqualified: interpreter portability to any other host (L1)
durability beyond this host and volume (L2)
accidental-commit protection for the local estate (L3)
disk headroom for a governed live run (L4)
which Git lineage is authoritative for the live run (L7)
cross-host binary identity of the compiled extensions (L9)
runtime-level rather than source-level edge proof (L10)

acceptance_answers.1_is_the_original_R7_fingerprint_defect_: YES on this host. Full 64-hex digests now exist for the interpreter, libpython and all five compiled extensions. The interpreter remains uncommitted, which is a portability caveat, not a fingerprint gap.
acceptance_answers.2_is_the_environment_durably_reusable: YES on this host. Non-temporary location, complete pinned inventory including narwhals, full recipe, positive control reproducing the accepted historical seed. Not portable without the interpreter binary.
acceptance_answers.3_was_the_exact_freeze_code_requalified_: YES. At rawlsing_next tree b0c1ab47, the freeze's own tree, the authoritative C3 six-file court ran 55/55 twice in the durable environment, source-free, with the denominator asserted before the run.
acceptance_answers.4_what_environment_identity_must_the_liv: Absolute interpreter /Users/matthewsmith/Desktop/Rawlsing/LOCAL_COURTS/qualification/r7-c4-source-free-venv/bin/python, base interpreter SHA-256 11d6f541a870a141249ce98d45834a6789e29c07031e85ce17f3e67f24c535f6, the 14 exactly-pinned packages including narwhals==2.26.0, and the five full extension digests in 01_RUNTIME_IDENTITY.json. The runner must also pin the exact rawlsing_next tree b0c1ab47, not a branch tip.
acceptance_answers.5_what_remains_unqualified: See what_remains_unqualified above; the material ones are interpreter portability (L1), accidental-commit protection (L3), disk headroom (L4) and the authoritative-lineage decision (L7).
